create_description: fix the crash in average when the input list is empty or missing
prompt: `average(nums)` in src/stats.mjs throws when the input list is empty, and the dashboard crashes whenever there are no samples yet. It should return 0 for an empty or missing list and the mean otherwise. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix. Keep the change focused.
trap_note: Symptom patch: guarding only `nums.length === 0` clears the empty-array case but still throws on a missing (null/undefined) list because it reads `.length` first. Root cause: guard non-arrays too (e.g. `!Array.isArray(nums) || nums.length === 0`).
